title: Non-Conforming Commercial Uses in Commercial Districts
previewText: In Commercial Districts, any non-conforming commercial use is listed in Use Groups IV, VI, VII, VIII, IX or X and permitted as-of-right within C7 Districts, may be changed, initially or in any subsequent change, only to a conforming use or to any commercial use permitted as-of-right in C2 Districts, other than those listed in Use Group V.
